scenarioTitle: More work than the department can hold
description: Planned hours exceed the annual capacity of the whole department by about a third, with tight ceilings on top. Provably infeasible: the correct behaviour is to fill what can be filled and report the rest. Included because the failure path is the one an algorithm is most likely to spend unbounded time in, and a paper should show it does not.
